projects.name: LLM-powered Search & Recommendation System
details: LLM-powered Search & Recommendation System
Built a semantic search and recommendation engine leveraging LLM
embeddings and hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword). Designed analytics
dashboards to monitor search relevance, user engagement, and
recommendation performance, enabling datadriven improvements in
knowledge management and personalization.
